title: Management body approves and oversees measures
summary: Management bodies approve the cybersecurity risk-management measures, oversee their implementation and can be held liable for infringements.
typical_evidence: Board or management approval of the security programme; oversight minutes

title: Management body training
summary: Members of management bodies follow cybersecurity training, and entities are encouraged to offer similar training to employees regularly.
typical_evidence: Training records for management body members

title: Appropriate and proportionate measures
summary: Take appropriate and proportionate technical, operational and organisational measures to manage risks to network and information systems, using an all-hazards approach and considering the state of the art, cost, size and exposure.

title: Risk analysis and information system security policies
summary: Policies on risk analysis and information system security.
typical_evidence: Risk analysis policy; information security policy

title: Incident handling
summary: Incident handling.

title: Business continuity and crisis management
summary: Business continuity such as backup management, disaster recovery and crisis management.
typical_evidence: BCP; DR plan; backup configuration; crisis management plan

title: Supply chain security
summary: Supply chain security including security aspects of relationships with direct suppliers and service providers.
typical_evidence: Supplier inventory; supplier security assessments; contract clauses

title: Security in acquisition, development and maintenance
summary: Security in acquiring, developing and maintaining network and information systems, including vulnerability handling and disclosure.
typical_evidence: SDLC policy; vulnerability management; disclosure policy

title: Assessing effectiveness of measures
summary: Policies and procedures to assess the effectiveness of cybersecurity risk-management measures.

title: Cyber hygiene and training
summary: Basic cyber hygiene practices and cybersecurity training.

title: Cryptography and encryption
summary: Policies and procedures on the use of cryptography and, where appropriate, encryption.

title: HR security, access control and asset management
summary: Human resources security, access control policies and asset management.
typical_evidence: HR security procedures; access control policy; asset inventory

title: MFA and secured communications
summary: Multi-factor or continuous authentication, secured voice, video and text communications, and secured emergency communication systems where appropriate.
typical_evidence: MFA enforcement exports; secure communication tools

title: Supplier-specific vulnerabilities
summary: Consider each direct supplier's specific vulnerabilities, the quality of its products and practices, and coordinated EU supply chain risk assessments.

title: Corrective measures
summary: Take the necessary appropriate and proportionate corrective measures without undue delay when non-compliance is found.

title: Notify significant incidents
summary: Notify the CSIRT or competent authority of any significant incident without undue delay, and inform recipients of the service where it is likely to affect them.
typical_evidence: Incident notification procedure; significance criteria; notification records

title: Early warning within 24 hours
summary: Submit an early warning within 24 hours of becoming aware of a significant incident, saying whether it may be caused by unlawful or malicious acts or have cross-border impact.

title: Incident notification within 72 hours
summary: Submit an incident notification within 72 hours of becoming aware, updating the early warning with an initial assessment of severity, impact and indicators of compromise.

title: Intermediate report on request
summary: Provide an intermediate report on relevant status updates when the CSIRT or authority asks.

title: Final report within one month
summary: Submit a final report within one month of the incident notification, with a detailed description, root cause, mitigation and cross-border impact.

title: Progress report for ongoing incidents
summary: Where the incident is still ongoing at the final report deadline, provide a progress report then and a final report within one month of handling it.

title: Use of certified ICT products
summary: Member States may require the use of certified ICT products, services and processes under European cybersecurity certification schemes.
typical_evidence: Only where the Member State requires it

title: Policy on the security of network and information systems
summary: Digital providers: a security policy approved by management; roles and responsibilities; reviewed at least annually.
typical_evidence: Approved security policy; roles; review records

title: Risk management policy
summary: Digital providers: a risk management framework; compliance monitoring; independent review of information and network security.
typical_evidence: Risk management framework; compliance monitoring; independent review

title: Incident handling
summary: Digital providers: incident handling policy; monitoring and logging; event reporting; assessment and classification; response; post-incident reviews.
typical_evidence: Incident policy; logging configuration; incident records

title: Business continuity and crisis management
summary: Digital providers: business continuity and DR plans; backup and redundancy management; crisis management.
typical_evidence: BCP and DR plans; backup tests; redundancy

title: Supply chain security
summary: Digital providers: supply chain security policy; directory of suppliers and service providers.

title: Security in acquisition, development and maintenance
summary: Digital providers: secure acquisition; secure development life cycle; configuration, change and patch management; security testing; network security and segmentation; malware protection; vulnerability handling and disclosure.
typical_evidence: SDLC; change records; patching; pen tests; network configuration

title: Assessing the effectiveness of measures
summary: Digital providers: policies and procedures to assess the effectiveness of cybersecurity risk-management measures.

title: Cyber hygiene and security training
summary: Digital providers: awareness raising and cyber hygiene; security training.

title: Cryptography
summary: Digital providers: a cryptography policy covering types, strength, key management and review.

title: Human resources security
summary: Digital providers: HR security; background verification; termination or change of employment procedures; disciplinary process.

title: Access control
summary: Digital providers: access control policy; access rights management; privileged accounts; system administration; identification; authentication; MFA.
typical_evidence: Access policy; access reviews; PAM; MFA exports

title: Asset management
summary: Digital providers: asset classification; handling; removable media policy; asset inventory; return or deletion on termination.

title: Environmental and physical security
summary: Digital providers: protection against supporting utility failure, physical and environmental threats; perimeter and physical access control.
typical_evidence: Cloud provider report; office physical controls
